text:
BillingBot: Automated reminder: Invoice INV-2025-772 (Acct: NebulaSoft) is 45 days past due. Balance: $48,700. Link: https://billing.redwood.com/invoices/INV-2025-772
Maya: @Alex saw their note about cashflow. They said they can do a partial wire today and want a short accrual schedule. Can we release the service hold after the partial posts?
Alex: They can wire $20,000 today, then $14,350 in 30 days, remainder in 60. Need written confirmation of amounts and the payment reference so we can apply correctly.
Priya: Customer CS confirms wire today with reference 'NEB-INV772-P1'. They also requested a one-time waiver of the late fee in exchange for the schedule.
Maya: We need legal signoff for any fee waiver. @Tom can you approve a one-off waiver conditional on signed plan + trace? Also want explicit non-precedent language.
Tom: Ok to approve a conditional waiver if we get: 1) signed payment addendum, 2) bank trace/wire confirmation for the $20k, 3) agreement no further credits. I'll draft a short addendum and send to the customer. ETA ~2 hours.
Maya: Please include an auto-reinstate clause for dunning if they miss a payment. Billing: confirm we apply remittance to the oldest balance by default.
Alex: They want API access restored immediately after the $20k posts. Ops will need the exact account ID to remove the hold. @Priya can you confirm?
Priya: Account ID NEB-9881. I'll monitor the bank remittance and ping ops. Customer will return signed plan within the hour.
Maya: Billing ops snippet to apply and release:
```
apply_payment invoice=INV-2025-772 amount=20000 ref=NEB-INV772-P1
/billing release-hold NEB-9881
```
BillingBot: Noted. When the payment posts with that ref, the billing collections queue will pick it up; manual override required to drop the hold.
Maya: Tasks: @Priya obtain signed addendum and upload; @Alex confirm wire by EOD PST; @Tom draft/send addendum; @Jo (Billing Ops) stand by to apply payment and release hold after verification.
Priya: Signed PDF incoming, cc'ing legal. Customer asked about crediting a portion of future overage; finance declined. They're okay proceeding with the schedule.
Alex: Wire confirmation expected ~14:23 PST today. I'll upload bank remittance when it's available. Can ops stand by for 30 minutes to confirm and release hold?
Jo (Billing Ops): On standby — watching bank feed. I will apply payment once remittance matches and then release the hold. Note: release requires manual approval from Maya or Tom.
Maya: I'll approve release once Jo confirms application. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
Priya: Uploaded signed addendum at 16:02 to internal drive: https://drive.internal/redwood/nebulasoft/addendum_INV772.pdf
Jo (Billing Ops): Payment applied at 16:37, ref NEB-INV772-P1. Partial credit $20,000 applied to oldest invoice. Hold released for NEB-9881.
Alex: Customer reports access restored, thanks everyone. I'll track next installment and confirm when wired.
Tom: Addendum sent to customer with auto-escalation clause for missed payments. Legal loop closed from our side.
BillingBot: Manual action completed and thread closed. Reminder for remaining balance scheduled for 2194320000.
